sources.title: Surogate Rune - a decision model that sees
sources.snippet: Rune answers questions about text and images with one of your options and a calibrated probability for every one, in a single pass. Open weights. See it decide on real inputs.

sources.title: rune-26b-a4b-GGUF: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Model Overview Overview rune-26b-a4b-GGUF is a multimodal decision model from Invergent, maintained by surogate. It takes a state—text, structured data, or an image with text—plus a question and candidate options, then returns a decision with probabilities in one forward pass.
